2608.04682.title: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
2608.04682.paper_summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software engineering (SWE) scenarios, capable of fixing a specific bug in large-scale codebase. However, existing SWE benchmarks typically assume that high-quality issue reports with detailed information are always available, which is easily violated in practice due to the complexity of report acquisition and curation. To address this, we introduce Active-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on proactively discovering and fixing multiple bugs without report guidance, covering 1,663 tasks across six bug categories and eight languages. Beyond shifting the focus from existing reactive bug fixing to proactive bug fixing, Active-SWE enables a more in-depth evaluation by expanding the scope from fixing a specific recorded bug to multiple-bug fixing and potential bug discovery scenarios. To construct Active-SWE, we propose a novel difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline with a dual-track evaluation framework, facilitating comprehensive evaluation of proactive bug-fixing capability. Extensive experiments reveal that most state-of-the-art coding agents struggle with proactive bug-fixing tasks, demonstrating limited performance in locating and resolving recorded bugs, handling multiple bug fixing scenarios, and discovering valid potential bugs.
2608.04682.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）驅動的編碼代理在軟體工程（SWE）場景中越來越受到採用，能夠修復大型代碼庫中的特定錯誤。<lb/>然而，現有的SWE基準通常假設高品質的問題報告總是可用，這在實踐中因報告獲取和整理的複雜性而容易被違反。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們介紹了Active-SWE，一個用於評估編碼代理主動發現和修復多個錯誤而不依賴報告指導的基準，涵蓋六個錯誤類別和八種語言的1,663個任務。<lb/>除了將重點從現有的被動錯誤修復轉向主動錯誤修復外，Active-SWE還通過將範圍從修復特定記錄的錯誤擴展到多個錯誤修復和潛在錯誤發現場景，實現了更深入的評估。<lb/>為了構建Active-SWE，我們提出了一個新穎的難度感知任務公式化管道，配合雙軌評估框架，促進了主動錯誤修復能力的全面評估。<lb/>廣泛的實驗顯示，大多數最先進的編碼代理在主動錯誤修復任務中表現不佳，顯示出在定位和解決記錄錯誤、處理多個錯誤修復場景以及發現有效潛在錯誤方面的能力有限。
